about.title: A compact studio with serious attention to the final result.
about.description: Drvenija combines CNC precision and hand finishing to create products that need to look polished, sellable, and durable.

precision.title: Precision
precision.text: Each piece starts with a clear technical drawing and ends with a manual quality check before dispatch.

flexibility.title: Flexibility
flexibility.text: We handle both one-off custom pieces and small-batch production for retail, events, and interiors.

speed.title: Speed
speed.text: Lead times are set realistically and communicated early, especially for business and seasonal work.

process.title: From first idea to finished piece without last-minute improvisation.
process.description: We first align size and intended use, prepare the CNC-ready file, finish the edges, and inspect each piece before packing.

steps.define: We define the product use case, dimensions, and visual direction.
steps.prepare: We prepare the CNC-ready file and align material and thickness.
steps.finish: We cut, finish the edges, and inspect each piece before dispatch.

trust.label: Why shop with us
trust.shippingText: We deliver anywhere in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
trust.madeText: Every piece is made to order.
trust.confirmText: You pay nothing until we confirm the details.

production.a: Each product page shows its production time. Most standard items are made within a few working days; for larger or custom orders we agree the timeline when confirming.

shipping.a: Delivery is free for orders from {freeFrom} KM. Smaller orders have a {fee} KM delivery fee.

payment.q: How do I pay for my order?
payment.a: After you place an order we review the details and email a confirmation with payment instructions. You pay nothing before that confirmation.

personalization.q: Can I add a name or my own text?
personalization.a: Yes. On products marked “Personalised”, enter your text in the personalisation field. We check that everything looks right before production.

mounting.a: Wall decor ships ready to mount. With your order you can tell us whether you prefer double-sided tape or screw holes.

custom.q: Can you work from my sketch or logo?
custom.a: Yes. Send a request through the Custom work page with your idea, size and deadline, and we will reply with a proposal and price.
